notes.title: What's changed in the full?
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello Zoo Managers! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]It’s almost time for the release of the full version of Zoo Simulator. 🤩 Before that happens, we’d like to show you our appreciation for all the feedback and positive energy you gave us. That’s why we’d like to show you a list of what to expect in the full version! 💪[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42911255/5819537d1719719a7b2fec0e5bda53f6d6c07ca8.png[/img]

[h3][b]🦏New animal species![/b][/h3]
That’s right! 10 new animals will be available in the full version, are you ready to provide for all of them and face the challenges coming with diversity?

[h3][b]⛱️ New enclosures[/b][/h3]
Your new animals will require specific conditions. We don’t want to leave you without help and that’s why we’re introducing 8 new enclosures!

[h3][b]🧰 New tools[/b][/h3]
With the amount of work awaiting you in the full version we’d like to give you some additional tools to ease the burden. We’re happy to announce 2 new tools coming in the full version: [b]wrench[/b] and [b]water dispenser[/b]. The water dispenser is especially appealing as it’ll help you automate the water pouring giving you more time for other activities.

[h3][b]🔧New mechanic- tap repairs[/b][/h3]
From now on the taps on the enclosures will break from time to time and require you to fix them.

[h3][b]🪑 New objects in the Building Mode[/b][/h3]
25 new items for you to place via Building Mode. This will bring even more variety and customization to your zoo.

[h3][b]🌱 New plants and furniture variants[/b][/h3]
We’re adding even more variety with the upcoming variants for the enclosure plants and furniture inside your office! Use them to make the zoo fit your vision even better than before!

[h3][b]🎒 New backpack mechanic[/b][/h3]
From now on, equipment management will be easier and more convenient than ever before! This will undoubtedly be a great help in your everyday activities all around the zoo. 

[h3][b]🚚 New mechanic- giving animals away to another zoo[/b][/h3]
You don’t feel sure you can provide the animal with the care it deserves? You’ve just started developing your zoo and have limited space? Now you can ask another zoo to relocate your animal to their garden! 

[h3][b]🎮 Rebinded controls[/b][/h3]
You’ve been pointing out that some of the controls are unintuitive therefore we’ve introduced changes to them! We’re positive now you’ll find them more natural.

[h3][b]↘️ New mechanic- item deterioration[/b][/h3]
It’s only natural that the items you use eventually break. From time to time you’ll have to do some maintenance work throughout your zoo. This will help you allow your guests to enjoy their stay more.

[h3][b]🤏 New mechanic- moving animals between enclosures[/b][/h3]
You have to fix the enclosure but the inhabitants make it harder for you to proceed? Now you can move them to another free enclosure as a temporary home for the time you finish repairs.

[h3][b]🐟 New food types[/b][/h3]
More animal variety means more dietary challenges- to make sure you can address all the animals’ food needs we’re introducing 2 new types of them- meat and fish.

[h3][b]🗑️ New utility item- trash can[/b][/h3]
No one likes to spend time in cluttered places. To help you keep your zoo clean we’re introducing trash cans. They’ll help you have cleaner space suitable for kids!

[h3][b]🗺️ Map with a quick travel feature[/b][/h3]
Sometimes there's too many things to do and you need to save as much time as possible. Use quick travel to instantly travel between the enclosures.

[h3][b]🏆 Progress awards[/b][/h3]
Effort is most satisfying when it doesn’t go unnoticed. With the new progress awards you’ll be able to earn prizes for developing your zoo.

[h3][b]📷 New tool- camera[/b][/h3]
Save the best moments of your animals and guests during everyday activities. Save all the breathtaking views and share them with your friends or other players on Steam!

[h3][b]💬 Lots of new tips, tutorial windows and clouds over objects requiring repair or interaction[/b][/h3]
Empty bowls, broken objects or new mechanics? Now everything will be explained and displayed even better than before! Those indicators will be of great help to grasp all the necessary actions all over the zoo.

[h3][b]💰 New item- Donation Box[/b][/h3]
Now the visitors can show their appreciation and help you develop your business with voluntary donations.

[h3][b]📱 Guests’ opinions system[/b][/h3]
From now on guests will react to the development of your Zoo as well as some of your actions. Make sure you always behave to receive positive notes!

[h3][b]👍 Reworked rating and reputation system[/b][/h3]
After the visits you’ll receive rating and positive or negative reputation depending on the visitor’s experience in your zoo. Quality of life improvements, keeping everything clean & fixed and making the animals happy is the key to running a successful zoo!

[h3][b]✔️ NEW achievement[/b][/h3]
31 new goals for our most ambitious players to aim for! Will you manage to complete all of them?

[h3][b]⚙️ More options in the settings[/b][/h3]
For the gameplay experience meeting all your personal expectations, we’re introducing even more options in the settings to adjust the game to your preferences.

[h3][b]😀 optimization, stability and UX improvements[/b][/h3]
Smoother gameplay with improved performance? We’ve introduced many upgrades to make every second spent in our game a more enjoyable experience! 

[b]We can’t wait to hear from you once you try out all the novelties in the full version. We’re positive you’ll find the game even more enjoyable than before! 🤩

If you don’t want to miss out on the premiere please 👇 join us on our discord and add the game to your wishlist 👇 to receive notification when the game is released! [/b]

notes.title: Damaged objects
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello Managers! 👋[/b][/h1]

Welcome back to our ZOO. In today’s devlog we’d like to introduce you to a new mechanic which is going to affect the daily life of your ZOO. It’s none other than the object deterioration system. 🔧

It’s only logical that objects deteriorate as you use them extensively. Sometimes one of the clumsier animals will destroy something while playing- it’s normal. Damaged objects become unusable, not to mention not appealing to both animals and the guests. One of the prime examples are information boards which are often used by the visitors of your ZOO.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42911255/dd272a207cf47fc953c329a25564c193d66468cb.png[/img]
That’s why in your ZOO some of the objects such as faucets, water dispensers or signs will deteriorate and require your attention. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42911255/5487e100792786d531a937cad57019f5becde148.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42911255/fbfbf1325fb171cee48fb606ff3dd471017afd9b.png[/img]
To help you during the repairs we’ve introduced a new tool- wrench which comes very helpful in replacing faucets or fixing the dispensers. 🧰

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42911255/a734a4add26f28cf34009c31f7fbaff8e0de5838.png[/img]
Although, you don’t have to move your animals to repair the enclosures, spending time around destroyed objects deteriorates animals’ statuses.

That’s why if you’d like to keep your animals in the best condition we suggest moving the animals to other enclosures until you finish the repairs. 👍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42911255/54bb06de99259ff951dc43e851285560b4bff05b.png[/img]
If you don’t have a free enclosure to move your animal or would like to have different species in your ZOO but you lack space, you can sell the animals to other ZOO and regain the money spent on obtaining it. We suggest selling only animals in their top condition because neglected animals are worth less.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42911255/40e47254c2f95bd550d3dbc4c2a3b55c6cf34347.png[/img]
[b]Introduction of this mechanic makes time management even more important. Keep in mind that your most important obligation is to the animals so make sure they’re always in their best possible condition! 🦏 [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2129220/Zoo_Simulator/

See you soon,
ZOO Simulator Team

[h1][b]Hello Managers 👋[/b][/h1]

Welcome back to another monthly devlog from ZOO Simulator! 🦏 As we’ve already said, we’d like to give you as much possibilities as we can. That’s why we’re especially happy to present the topic of today’s devlog- the renovation system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42911255/a8c30ba6d71107075c0881e5cf8cd0014b693eb5.png[/img]
Throughout your gameplay you’ll be able to not only fix and change the animal enclosures but also other buildings. In general, the entire system can be divided into 4 separate categories:

[h3][b]Office 🖥️[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Decorations
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello Managers! 👋[/b][/h1]

Welcome back to the ZOO. First of all, we’d really like to thank you all for your feedback during the Steam Next Fest. 💝 We’ve heard you loud and clear and now we know which aspects should be polished. We hope you’ll keep supporting us and together we’ll create a great game! 🙂

[h3]Today, we’d like to show you yet another aspect of the game-[b] the decorating system[/b]! 💎[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42911255/66599b9cac32c750aadf3e10147535ae8a816564.png[/img]
[h3][b]So, how does the player decorate the enclosures? 🤔[/b][/h3]

Player decorates the enclosures in the decoration mode. To be able to use that mode the player must enter the enclosure. Once in there, the HUD will display information to press “V”. Completing this action will turn on the mode in which you’ll be able to choose different objects sorted into different categories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42911255/945be615b2811ab0cbc9b75dc810f485c07495a1.png[/img]
After picking the object you can start maneuvering it to place it in the best possible spot.

[h3][b]What objects will be available? 📝[/b][/h3]

At your disposal there will be various elements sorted in [b]4 different categories[/b]:

[h3][b]Food and Water 🥫[/b][/h3]
Category where all the troughs and water bowls of various sizes are stored.

[h3][b]Shelter 🏠[/b][/h3]
Pick the best home tailored for each of your cute animals


[h3][b]Enclosure decorations 💟[/b][/h3]
Different kinds of objects enchanting the looks of the enclosures

[h3][b]Toys 🧸[/b][/h3]
Different objects your animals will be able to interact and play with. Additionally, later in the game different objects will be available to place outside of the enclosures to increase the guests’ opinion on your ZOO.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42911255/ddb98df56c2a949b29d87cb56f3aba83e5242f9b.png[/img]
What impact do the decorations have on the gameplay?

Decorations allow you to create a truly unique, eye-catching garden you’ll be proud to manage. What’s more, animals have their needs which are to be regulated. One of those needs is the previously mentioned Fun. Player has to provide the animals with proper toys, fitted for different kinds of animals. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42911255/f8a13b07f56e9886238f5b9537fdfba6a1d8bb59.png[/img]
The amount of decorations improves the rating of the enclosure and as the result, the rating of your ZOO. The higher your rating is, the more visitors you’ll have. We suppose it goes without saying the earnings will rise too! 📈

We can’t wait to hear your opinions on the decorations! Make sure to let us know in the comments and on our discord 👇. If you enjoy our work, please help us reach more and more people by adding the game to your Wishlists on Steam!

notes.title: Tools
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello Managers 👋[/b][/h1]

Welcome back to our ZOO! It’s been a while since the last devlog and in the meantime our place bought two new accessories to help you take even better care of all the animals in your garden! 🤩 Let’s take a closer look, shall we?

[h3]The first tool we’d like to discuss is [b]the welder[/b]. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42911255/e00fc8e6ab470ccf63502b49fd7909a72e0c8df2.png[/img]
Sometimes, [b]fragments of the enclosures like gates may break and require repair[/b]. In the demo version, you’re going to encounter only one of such elements- the entry gate to the enclosure. In the final version, [b]we plan to add more possibilities such as repairing fences[/b] etc. 🙂 Don’t ignore the damages to the enclosure as [b]safety should always be a priority[/b]! After all, it’s all for the sake of both your guests and the animals in your care! 🦏

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42911255/d506edb3c69a6895645c7279aae5f4a9e4abb734.gif[/img]
[h3]The second tool at your disposal is none other than [b]the pressure washer[/b]! 💦[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42911255/2534ef650e2758ed2f1c7163ba4203ab86d4b798.png[/img]
The pressure washer will allow you to clean the enclosures. In the demo version, players will be required to clean the enclosure only before putting the animal inside but in the final version that’s going to change. 📝 [b]The full version will require you to clean the enclosures every once in a while to keep the residing animal healthy[/b]. 🦁

[b]It is in your best interest to not neglect this duty because not keeping the hygiene on an acceptable level will have detrimental consequences. [/b]🙁 Not only will the animal feel worse but this will also lead to guest being less interested. As you can imagine, that’s going to make you have both less guests and income. 😿

As you can see, it’s extremely important to keep a close eye on the cleanliness level inside the enclosures 👀 as it does correlate with the amount of money you’ll be able to make, hence- your possibilities to grow and take better care of the animals you’ve already acquired.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42911255/f4b9b9b88dcae681c93aeb865dabaae4d536727d.gif[/img]
[h3]Don’t worry! In the final version you’ll receive all the actual data through the computer in your office for easier surveillance 👍 [/h3]

Hopefully you’ll find both new tools helpful. Let us know in the comments what other tools we should add to the game, we can’t wait to hear your ideas 🙂 If you like the development process, [b]consider adding this game you your wishlists [/b]👇

[h2]This month, we’ve given our undivided attention to the animals. We’ve decided to implement a system of animals’ needs communicating with players via a comic cloud 💭 over their heads. [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42911255/37ed1d14991f022eb41d2748c6bee7c0d3452f92.png[/img]
[h3]By now, you may have asked yourselves, what needs are they able to communicate to us?🤔 Don’t worry, the list below will provide you with all of them! 🤩

[b]- Sleepiness,
- Hunger,
- Thirst,
- Information about an empty water or food supply in the enclosure,
- Relaxation,
- Fun,
- Socialization.[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42911255/646fa0cd1e5cd850f3d9929f533ec294954f7d11.png[/img]
In order to meet the first 4 needs, players will have to pay attention so that each of your pupils get fresh water and food delivery regularly and organize them a peaceful environment where they could fall asleep. 🤫

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42911255/9b9e73735451272ceb8b87c2fce55ef278fa76d0.png[/img]
Other three needs will require the players to interact with the animal or its surroundings. 🏞️ Be it adding a new animal to the enclosure or simply some new toys. Satisfying all the needs your animals have will make all your animal species’ appearance and feeling much better! This directly impacts your income 💰 as it makes your ZOO gain reputation which directly increases the number of visitors! 👏

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42911255/fe212880712dd48b9120e35f41f126d74477f600.png[/img]
[h3]Keep in mind that ignoring your pupils needs will also have dire consequences. Deteriorating reputation will eventually cause you lots of money issues as the guests will not be willing to visit. 🐒[/h3]

That brings us to the end of our short trip! What do you think about our new system? [b]Join our discord [/b]👇 and let us know! 🤩 Don’t forget to [b]add our game to your wishlists [/b]👇 on Steam and you’ll hear from us next month in another devlog!
